headline: Diesel tops $6/gal as DPA invoked for Delek refinery expansion
intro: Refined products are the story again: diesel's north of $6 at the pump, Ukraine just torched a Russian refinery, and the White House is dusting off Korean War-era powers to grow a Texas plant. Crack spreads are doing the talking while crude just sits there.
overview: Diesel cracks remain extraordinarily wide ($101.71/bbl) with ULSD spot at $4.713 and retail diesel at $6.179, as the IEA flags persistent global diesel tightness and historically low inventories tied to Middle East export disruptions. Geopolitics is compounding the squeeze: Ukraine resumed drone strikes on Russian refineries (hitting Ryazan overnight) after ending a US-brokered pause, while a container ship sank in the Strait of Hormuz, both renewing supply-risk premiums. On the policy side, the Trump administration is using the Defense Production Act to expand Delek's Tyler, Texas refinery, and DOE issued its 45Z emissions-value request process for clean fuel producers alongside fresh SAF/renewable diesel capacity news from LanzaJet, XCF Global, and Continental Refining.

stories.title: Energy Markets Juggle Supply Risks, Inflation Pressures, And Geopolitical Conflict
stories.summary: Refined products sold off Thursday with RBOB down 8 cents on the day (13 for the week) even as WTI logged a sixth straight daily gain; ULSD futures remain up more than 6 cents for the week.

stories.title: IEA: Oil supply rebound remains fragile; diesel tightness persists
stories.summary: IEA warns global diesel and refined product markets face prolonged tightness, with inventories at historic lows driven by Middle East export disruptions and geopolitical tensions.

stories.title: Diesel Above $6 Is a Refining Shortage, Not an Oil Problem - and Refiners Are the Ones Cashing In
stories.summary: US diesel above $6/gallon reflects a refining capacity shortage rather than a crude price problem, as global exports fell roughly 1 million bpd amid Iran-Russia conflicts.

stories.title: As Soaring Energy Prices Boost Inflation, Refiners Have Become Money Machines
stories.summary: A 9.1% monthly jump in gasoline prices drove more than half of August's 0.6% rise in consumer prices, and refiners are posting outsized profits amid the price surge.

stories.title: White House Turns to Korean War-Era Law as Diesel Prices Stay Above $6
stories.summary: The White House is invoking the Defense Production Act to expand Delek's 74,000-bpd Delek Tyler, Texas refinery as diesel prices hold above $6/gallon.

stories.title: USA to Use Cold War Era Law to Expand Texas Refinery
stories.summary: VP JD Vance announced the administration will use the Cold War-era Defense Production Act to work with Delek U.S. Holdings to expand its Texas refinery.

stories.title: What the Defense Production Act Push at Delek’s Tyler Refinery Means for Your Fuel Bill
stories.summary: Analysis questions what the DPA push at Delek's Tyler refinery will actually do for fuel prices, noting diesel is at $6.32 with no published cost breakdown.

stories.title: Ukraine resumes refinery strikes in Russia as Zelenskiy criticises US intelligence withdrawal
stories.summary: Ukraine resumed refinery strikes inside Russia, with a drone attack sparking a fire at a refinery in Ryazan, as Zelensky criticized the US over intelligence withdrawal.

stories.title: Container Ship Sinks in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: A Singapore-flagged container ship sank in the Strait of Hormuz after all 21 crew were evacuated safely, raising fresh shipping-risk concerns in a key chokepoint.

stories.title: First tanker leaves Russia under Trump’s diesel deal
stories.summary: The first tanker has left Russia under the Trump administration's new diesel-related deal, per TradeWinds.

stories.title: US DOE releases emissions-value request process for 45Z clean fuel production credit
stories.summary: US DOE released its emissions-value request (EVR) process, the route for clean fuel producers to obtain provisional emission rates from DOE and petition Treasury for 45Z tax credits.

stories.title: What Net-Zero Policies Add to Your Fuel and Power Bill, State by State
stories.summary: State-level net-zero and clean-fuel policies are adding meaningfully to fuel costs: California's Cap-and-Invest/LCFS added about 47 cents/gallon in July, Washington's carbon rules add 36-74 cents.

stories.title: LanzaJet Secures $20 Million in New Financing to Advance Freedom Pines Fuels Operations and Growth
stories.summary: LanzaJet secured $20 million in new financing to advance operations and growth at its Freedom Pines Fuels SAF facility.

stories.title: Ashley Hinson Touts Win for Iowa Farmers as GOP Senate Seat Under Threat
stories.summary: Rep. Ashley Hinson touted a proposed EPA revision to renewable fuel standard rules she says will expand target markets for American farmers.
